C1674.title: CI/CD Security Review: Exploiting Leaked Credentials for Attacks
C1674.summary: A systematic literature review reveals that attackers have recently exploited credentials leaked from CI/CD pipelines to replace cached objects with malicious content. Since downstream dependencies typically trust these pipelines, this leads to severe security consequences.

references.title: SoK: Understanding CI/CD Security: A Comprehensive Review of Architecture, Attacks, and Defenses
